_comment: Template: Generate the RDFS serialisation info (RdfAbout and RdfEnum members) of RDFS profiles.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar rdfs-serialisation --config this-file.json
_note_rdfsFiles: RDFS profiles (RDF/XML). Each needs an owl:Ontology header (RDFS 2020) or CGMES 2.4 entsoeURI items.
